name: io.github.KyTheKitty/verifyapi
title: VerifyAPI — fact-check with signed receipts
description: Fact-check any claim with live web sources. Ed25519-signed receipts. Catches hallucinations.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFYAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your VerifyAPI key (csk_live_...). Get one free at https://verify-api.dev/signup — no card required. Unset = free trial (3 calls per IP per 24h, cached tier, signed receipts still included).

environmentVariables.name: VERIFYAPI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.verify-api.dev.
